overview: This illustrative PR is the base of the stack: it adds an append-only
per account and a recorder service that later PRs call. Admins and owners get a read-only list through a new
. Nothing writes events yet, so the recorder is unused until the API-key PR above it. The snippets are synthetic and no tests were run.

topics.title: The audit event table
paragraphs: Events belong to an account with a non-null foreign key and carry an action name plus a JSON metadata column. The composite index on account and creation time matches the only query in this PR, the recent list. Account deletes its events with delete_all, which skips callbacks; that is fine for an append-only log but worth confirming against retention requirements.

topics.title: Who can read the log
paragraphs: The permission map grants audit_log.read to owners and admins, and the controller authorizes it before loading at most 100 recent events. The request spec covers the admin path only; a member being refused is not shown.
